writing.sample_en:
【参考范文 · 169 词】写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
People are now increasingly aware of the danger of ‘appearance anxiety’ or being obsessed with one’s looks. This uneasiness rarely appears out of nowhere. Bombarded daily by filtered images and narrow aesthetic standards on social media, many young people measure themselves against unreachable models and feel that they never look good enough. The constant comparison quietly drains their confidence and even distracts them from things that truly matter.
Yet a healthier attitude is well within our reach. The key is to shift attention from the mirror to inner value — our knowledge, kindness and abilities. I once spent hours worrying about a small scar before a presentation, until a friend reminded me that the audience remembered my ideas, not my face. That moment taught me that self-acceptance, rather than a flawless appearance, is what sets us free.
In short, looks are only a thin surface of who we are. Once we learn to value character over appearance, ‘appearance anxiety’ loses its grip, and we can live with genuine confidence.

lines.en: M: Thanks for inviting me out tonight. I've been wanting to try this place for weeks. I usually pass it on my way home from work but never seem to have time to stop.
lines.zh: M：谢谢你今晚邀请我出来。我一直想来这家店试试，已经好几个星期了。我通常下班回家的路上会经过这里，但似乎总是没时间停下来。

lines.en: W: I've been dying to come here as well. I was worried that the menu might not be accommodating. But one of my close friends ate here last week. She's a vegetarian. She told me that there were a lot of options for her, and they offered alternative dishes.
lines.zh: W：我也一直特别想来这里。我当时还担心菜单可能不太适合不同的饮食需求。不过，我有一位好朋友上周来这里吃过饭。她是素食者。她告诉我，这里有很多适合她的选择，而且他们还会提供替代菜品。

lines.en: M: But you're not vegetarian, are you?
lines.zh: M：不过你不是素食者，对吧？

lines.en: W: Well, not entirely. I don't eat meat at all, but I don't have a problem eating fish, seafood or eggs.
lines.zh: W：嗯，也不完全是。我一点肉都不吃，但鱼、海鲜和鸡蛋我都可以吃。

lines.en: M: Isn't that very difficult? I can't imagine giving up a premium juicy steak or bacon cheeseburgers.
lines.zh: M：这不是很难吗？我无法想象放弃上等的多汁牛排或培根芝士汉堡。

lines.en: W: I wouldn't know. My parents followed the same diet. Even when I was younger, we never had meat during meals, and I never really had a craving to try it. I bet it would be hard though, giving up something you're accustomed to eating. I tried cutting back on coffee in the morning, and it was awful. Come to think of it, it was probably even worse for my colleagues that had to deal with me at morning meetings.
lines.zh: W：我也不知道。我父母遵循的也是同样的饮食习惯。甚至在我小的时候，我们吃饭时也从来不吃肉，而我也从来没有特别想尝试。话说回来，放弃一种你已经习惯吃的东西，肯定会很难。我试过早上少喝咖啡，感觉糟透了。现在想想，那段时间可能对我的同事来说更糟，因为他们得在早会上应付我。

lines.en: M: That's even harder to imagine you, without coffee. So you say your parents also followed a partially vegetarian diet? Why did they decide to do that?
lines.zh: M：我更难想象没有咖啡的你。你是说你父母也遵循半素食饮食？他们为什么决定这样做？

lines.en: W: That's an interesting question. I never thought to ask them though. My best guess is for health reasons. They're not terribly active or knowledgeable about animal preservation efforts, but they're serious about their health. Both are in their 70s now, but eat organic as often as possible and take part in regular physical exercise. Neither of them has any health problems, and they hardly ever get sick.
lines.zh: W：这是个有意思的问题。不过我从来没想过要问他们。我的最大猜测是出于健康原因。他们并不是特别活跃，也不太了解动物保护方面的工作，但他们非常重视自己的健康。他们现在都七十多岁了，却尽可能经常吃有机食品，还定期参加体育锻炼。他们俩都没有任何健康问题，而且几乎从来不会生病。

lines.en: M: In that case, I might give it a try someday.
lines.zh: M：这样的话，也许哪天我会试试看。

lines.en: W: Now back to the menu. What are you going to have?
lines.zh: W：现在回到菜单上来。你打算吃什么？

lines.en: W: How did your annual performance evaluation meeting with your manager go? Did you get much in the way of praise?
lines.zh: W: 你和经理的年度绩效评估会议进行得怎么样？他有没有怎么表扬你？

lines.en: M: Next to zero. When we came to the part about discussing my areas for growth, he bluntly told me that I had an attitude problem. But he wouldn't really expand on that description. He said it's the little things I do and say.
lines.zh: M: 几乎没有。谈到讨论我需要改进的方面时，他直截了当地告诉我，我的态度有问题。但他并没有进一步解释这个说法。他说，是我做的一些小事和说的一些话造成的。

lines.en: W: Did you ask him for a specific example?
lines.zh: W: 你有没有让他举个具体的例子？

lines.en: M: I did ask him a few more questions to try and narrow it down. He said my constant questioning of him and his decisions was the most obvious example he could give. Then our conversation was swiftly brought to a close.
lines.zh: M: 我确实又问了几个问题，想把范围缩小一些。他说，我不断质疑他和他的决定，就是他能举出的最明显的例子。然后我们的谈话很快就结束了。

lines.en: W: I had a similar experience once. My manager told me I was too honest. In most cases, I thought my honesty was helpful, as did my colleagues, but my manager thought otherwise. Some managers really adopt manipulative language to disguise the unreasonable choices they have made. They don't use the rational power of arguments to resolve issues of conflict or complaints about unfairness.
lines.zh: W: 我以前也有过类似的经历。我的经理说我太诚实了。大多数情况下，我觉得我的诚实是有帮助的，我的同事也这么认为，但我的经理却不这么想。有些经理确实会采用操纵性的语言，来掩饰他们做出的不合理选择。他们不会运用论证的理性力量，来解决冲突问题或人们对不公平的抱怨。

lines.en: M: Right. Some employ their persuasive vocabulary and influential communication style to win workplace arguments by compelling people to perform the intended action.
lines.zh: M: 没错。有些人会运用有说服力的词汇和具有影响力的沟通方式，通过迫使人们采取预期的行动来赢得职场争论。

lines.en: W: Exactly. Too honest? Isn't that a good thing? I thought that's surely something we should have covered earlier in the section discussing strengths and talents, but no. Honesty was deemed to be more of a sin than a virtue, since it made people feel uncomfortable, or at least it made the most powerful folks feel uncomfortable.
lines.zh: W: 正是。太诚实了？这难道不是一件好事吗？我本以为这肯定是我们早些时候在讨论优势和才能的部分应该涉及的内容，但事实并非如此。诚实被认为更像是一种罪过，而不是一种美德，因为它让人感到不自在，或者至少让那些最有权势的人感到不自在。

lines.en: M: Indeed. Rhetoric is viewed by many philosophers as the method through which the powerful accumulate more power. By virtue of having the loudest voice, they're able to command greater attention and to further assert their dominance, even when what they're saying doesn't really make much sense.
lines.zh: M: 的确如此。许多哲学家认为，修辞是有权势者积累更多权力的手段。凭借最大的声音，他们能够获得更多关注，并进一步巩固自己的支配地位，即使他们所说的话其实没什么道理。

lines.en: W: And retaining their power and prestige is their priority.
lines.zh: W: 而保住他们的权力和声望才是他们的首要任务。

lines.en: M: It's what makes the most sense to a lot of them.
lines.zh: M: 对很多人来说，这才是最合理的做法。

lines.en: Athletes are seen as heroes because they can do things that most of us can't do. They can hit fastballs coming at them at nearly 100 miles an hour, and leap and hang in the air, seemingly defying gravity. They get paid millions of dollars for their efforts, and their names and faces appear on everything from running shoes to advertising boards.
lines.zh: 运动员被视为英雄，是因为他们能做到我们大多数人做不到的事情。他们能击中以接近每小时100英里的速度飞向他们的快速球，还能跃起并悬停在空中，似乎在对抗重力。他们因自己的努力而获得数百万美元的报酬，他们的名字和面孔出现在从跑鞋到广告牌的各种物品上。

lines.en: Athletes who are champions also show qualities such as perseverance, dedication, and the ability to keep their cool under pressure. Many show those same qualities off the playing field, too. Stories about superstar athletes teach us about working hard and believing in ourselves and then being passionate about what we do. Although it's usually bad behavior that gets an athlete a spot on the six o'clock news, many high-profile players work hard to be positive role models to children. They raise money for charities and act as mentors, talking to student groups and volunteering their time to programs that help children keep off drugs and stay in school.
lines.zh: 成为冠军的运动员还展现出诸如毅力、奉献以及在压力下保持冷静的能力等品质。许多人在赛场之外也展现出相同的品质。关于超级巨星运动员的故事教导我们要努力拼搏、相信自己，并对自己所做的事情充满热情。尽管通常是不良行为让运动员登上六点钟新闻，但许多备受关注的球员仍努力成为孩子们积极的榜样。他们为慈善机构筹集资金并担任导师，与学生群体交流，并志愿为帮助儿童远离毒品和留在学校的项目奉献时间。

lines.en: Still, even the greatest champions have flaws. Just because an athlete has the perfect golf swing doesn't mean he is the perfect parent, friend or spokesperson. They also make mistakes. Separating an athlete's professional and personal lives can be tough. When a sports star gets in trouble with the law, or does something wrong in their private life, fans are often left disappointed. Before he died, baseball star Mickey Mantle, who was plagued with alcohol problems, told young ballplayers and the fans who admired him "to play like me, don't be like me."
lines.zh: 尽管如此，即使是最伟大的冠军也有缺陷。不能仅凭一名运动员拥有完美的高尔夫挥杆动作，就意味着他是完美的父母、朋友或代言人。他们也会犯错。将运动员的职业生活与个人生活区分开来可能会很困难。当体育明星触犯法律，或在私生活中做错事时，粉丝往往会感到失望。棒球巨星米奇·曼特尔生前饱受酗酒问题困扰，他在去世前曾对年轻球员和崇拜他的球迷说：“像我一样打球，不要像我一样做人。”

lines.en: We don't need to tell you that weddings can get expensive. Even with the most meticulous budgeting, a few unexpected costs are bound to occur. While most brides tend to accept this as fact, one Canadian woman, who is only known as Susan, attempted to avoid all wedding costs. She did this by asking her friends and family to pay up to attend her wedding. It went about as well as you'd expect. Susan is causing quite the debate online after posting a bizarre Facebook complaint about her now-cancelled wedding.
lines.zh: 我们无需告诉你，婚礼可能会变得非常昂贵。即使预算安排得最为周密，也必然会出现一些意料之外的开支。大多数新娘往往会接受这一事实，但一名仅以 Susan 为人所知的加拿大女子却试图避开所有婚礼费用。她要求亲朋好友付费参加自己的婚礼。结果正如你所料，事情进展得相当不顺利。Susan 在 Facebook 上发布了一篇抱怨她那场如今已经取消的婚礼的奇怪帖子后，在网上引发了激烈争论。

lines.en: Yes, the couple called off the wedding just days before their wedding vows. Since their guests refused to pay the $1,500 attendance fee, the $60,000 dream wedding was put on permanent hold. In her long explanation filled with cursing and swearing, the bride accused her friends and family of ruining her marriage and her life. She stated that each guest would only need to pay $1,500 while she sacrificed everything for the day. Her maid of honor told her to stick to the budget, as she was asking too much from her guests. But Susan ignored her. Not surprisingly, only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests.
lines.zh: 没错，这对情侣在交换结婚誓言前几天取消了婚礼。由于宾客拒绝支付 1,500 美元的参加费用，这场价值 60,000 美元的梦幻婚礼被无限期搁置。在那篇充斥着咒骂和脏话的长篇解释中，新娘指责亲朋好友毁掉了她的婚姻和人生。她表示，每位宾客只需支付 1,500 美元，而她为了这一天牺牲了一切。她的伴娘告诉她要遵守预算，因为她向宾客索要的费用太高了。但 Susan 没有理会她。毫不意外，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和付款请求作出了积极回应。

lines.en: Realizing they would not be able to afford their dream wedding, Susan's future husband suggested getting married in Las Vegas. The bride quickly shut down the idea, saying she did not want a wedding of gambling and heavy drinking. It seems her dream wedding has now become a nightmare.
lines.zh: 意识到他们将无法负担梦幻婚礼后，Susan 的未婚夫建议去拉斯维加斯结婚。新娘很快否决了这个想法，称她不想要一场充斥着赌博和酗酒的婚礼。看来，她的梦幻婚礼如今已经变成了一场噩梦。

lines.en: It has long been scientifically established that weather changes can affect people's moods. Now, a new study has provided evidence that temperature can influence people's personalities. This study of over 1.6 million people revealed that 22 degrees Celsius is the perfect air temperature to live in. A city with an average annual temperature closer to 22 tends to have a population who are more agreeable, conscientious, emotionally stable, and outgoing. It is the least taxing temperature for the body to regulate its own temperature.
lines.zh: 天气变化会影响人的情绪，这一点早已得到科学证实。如今，一项新的研究提供了温度能够影响人们性格的证据。这项针对超过160万人的研究显示，22摄氏度是最适合居住的空气温度。年平均气温更接近22摄氏度的城市，其居民往往更加随和、尽责、情绪稳定且外向。这是人体调节自身温度时负担最小的温度。

lines.en: The study was observational and didn't show cause and effect, but the scientists behind it theorized that better weather leads people to leave their home more often. This, in turn, leads to more social interaction, which encourages them to develop a friendlier and socially more acceptable personality. Warmer climates also make people feel more positive in general. They tend to be more agreeable and conscientious.
lines.zh: 这项研究属于观察性研究，并未证明因果关系，但研究背后的科学家推测，更宜人的天气会使人们更频繁地外出。这样一来，人们会有更多的社交互动，从而促使他们形成更加友善、在社交方面更容易被接受的性格。较温暖的气候通常也会让人们更加积极乐观。他们往往更加随和、尽责。

lines.en: The findings might help explain why colder and warmer countries tend to produce people with different personalities. Roughly speaking, about 40% of a person's personality is determined by their genes, the other 60% by their environment. It was already well-known that personality traits vary across geographic regions. Scientists also knew that these geographic personality traits are associated with a broad range of consequential outcomes. These outcomes include economic activity, for example, entrepreneurial start-up rates, and also crime rates, health behaviors, and health outcomes.
lines.zh: 这些发现或许有助于解释为什么较寒冷和较温暖的国家往往会孕育出性格不同的人。大致来说，一个人的性格约有40%由基因决定，另外60%由环境决定。众所周知，性格特征在不同地理区域之间存在差异。科学家们还知道，这些与地理区域相关的性格特征与广泛的重要结果有关。这些结果包括经济活动，例如创业企业的初创率，也包括犯罪率、健康行为和健康状况。

lines.en: And it is well established that personality traits differ between countries. The research team speculated the two might be linked. To test this, they gave online personality tests to 5,587 Chinese students and 1.66 million Americans. They then compared the results with the average annual temperature where they grew up. The tests measured personality along five well-studied characteristics. The five were agreeability, conscientiousness, emotional stability, outgoingness, and openness to new experiences. In both groups, the researchers found the closer a town's average annual temperature was to 22 degrees, the more its population exhibited those personality characteristics.
lines.zh: 此外，不同国家之间的性格特征存在差异，这一点也已得到充分证实。研究团队推测，这两者可能存在联系。为了检验这一点，他们对5587名中国学生和166万名美国人进行了在线性格测试。随后，他们将测试结果与这些人长大所在地的年平均气温进行了比较。这些测试依据五项经过充分研究的特征来衡量性格。这五项特征分别是随和性、尽责性、情绪稳定性、外向性以及对新体验的开放性。在两组人群中，研究人员都发现，一个城镇的年平均气温越接近22摄氏度，其居民越明显地表现出这些性格特征。

lines.en: However, the findings were much stronger for the Chinese group than the Americans studied, which suggests that though temperature plays a role, it does not play a dominant role. The effects are fairly weak. It's unlikely to lead to many arguments over the temperature setting of the office air conditioner.
lines.zh: 然而，这些发现对中国群体的解释力远强于对所研究的美国人的解释力，这表明尽管温度确实发挥作用，但并非起主导作用。其影响相当微弱。因此，温度设定不太可能引发许多关于办公室空调温度的争论。

lines.en: Today, we are talking about loneliness. Loneliness and social isolation are growing public health concerns for people of all ages in the United States, from adolescence to the elderly. Public health experts are worried because loneliness seems to be on the rise, and studies have long found correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions that threaten health and longevity.
lines.zh: 今天，我们来谈谈孤独。对于美国各个年龄段的人来说，从青少年到老年人，孤独和社会隔离正日益成为令人担忧的公共卫生问题。公共卫生专家对此感到担忧，是因为孤独似乎正在增加，而研究长期以来一直发现，孤独与一系列威胁健康和长寿的疾病之间存在相关性。

lines.en: The problem of loneliness may be even greater than we thought. A new national poll found that about a third of older Americans are lonely, and almost as many seniors feel isolated. This is a serious problem as research shows that chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens. That's because it can impair older adults' memory and damage their physical and mental health. Chronic loneliness even impacts the life expectancy of seniors, increasing their risk of early mortality.
lines.zh: 孤独问题可能比我们想象的还要严重。一项新的全国性民意调查发现，大约三分之一的美国老年人感到孤独，几乎同样多的老年人感到与社会隔绝。研究表明，长期孤独对老年人尤其有害，因此这是一个严重的问题。这是因为孤独会损害老年人的记忆，并危害他们的身体和心理健康。长期孤独甚至会影响老年人的预期寿命，增加他们过早死亡的风险。

lines.en: Let's take a closer look at that poll now. More than a third of seniors in the poll said they felt lonely at least some of the time, and 27% said they sometimes or often felt isolated. This reflects how much time the seniors spent with others. Almost 30% said they socialized with friends, family or neighbors once a week or less. Women were more likely than men to report loneliness.
lines.zh: 现在，让我们进一步了解这项民意调查。调查中超过三分之一的老年人表示，他们至少有一部分时间感到孤独，27%的人表示自己有时或经常感到与社会隔绝。这反映了老年人与他人相处的时间。近30%的人表示，他们每周与朋友、家人或邻居社交的次数不超过一次。女性报告感到孤独的可能性高于男性。

lines.en: But there is good news. It looks like loneliness can be reversed. But researchers are still trying to determine the best way to do so. Why is that? Resolving the problem of loneliness among seniors often isn't as simple as getting them together with others or moving them in with their children. In fact, the poll found that seniors who lived with their children were more likely to report feeling lonely than those who didn't. This may be because loneliness refers to the discrepancy between actual and desired relationships. So it's possible that someone who lives alone doesn't meet that definition, while someone in a house full of busy people does.
lines.zh: 但也有好消息。看来孤独是可以得到改善的。不过，研究人员仍在努力确定最佳方法。为什么会这样呢？解决老年人的孤独问题，往往并不像让他们与他人聚在一起或让他们搬去和子女同住那么简单。事实上，调查发现，与子女同住的老年人比不与子女同住的老年人更有可能报告自己感到孤独。这可能是因为，孤独指的是实际关系与期望关系之间的差距。因此，一个独居的人可能不符合这一定义，而一个住在满是忙碌人群的房子里的人却可能符合。

lines.en: How can we solve the problem? Well, the researchers assert that it's important to address each person's underlying cause of loneliness, whether it's the death of a spouse, medical problems, or social expectations that haven't been fulfilled. It's noteworthy that there is one general recommendation. While finding solutions for loneliness is highly personal, research suggests the best interventions are those that involve meaningful social contact at least once a week. Depending on the person, that could mean volunteering, seeing an old friend or something else.
lines.zh: 我们该如何解决这个问题呢？研究人员认为，重要的是要解决每个人孤独感背后的根本原因，无论是配偶去世、健康问题，还是未能满足的社会期望。值得注意的是，有一条普遍建议。虽然寻找孤独问题的解决方案高度因人而异，但研究表明，最佳干预措施是至少每周进行一次有意义的社会接触。根据个人情况，这可能意味着参加志愿活动、去见一位老朋友，或者采取其他方式。

lines.en: Hello, I'm co-founder of the popular female travel community We Are Travel Girls. We collect and publish stories from women traveling all over the world. We promote women's blogs; we host meetings and events and are getting ready to launch our Travel With Us trips in Bali, Japan and Malawi.
lines.zh: 你好，我是广受欢迎的女性旅行社区 We Are Travel Girls 的联合创始人。我们收集并发表世界各地女性旅行者的故事，推广女性博客，举办聚会和活动，并正准备推出在巴厘岛、日本和马拉维的“与我们一起旅行”旅程。

lines.en: Before I started We Are Travel Girls, I had a successful 10-year career in finance in London, where I advised private clients on their investments. Having always had a huge love for travel, I finally took the leap and left finance to pursue my dream of starting a travel company.
lines.zh: 在创办 We Are Travel Girls 之前，我在伦敦的金融行业拥有一份成功的十年职业生涯，为私人客户提供投资方面的建议。我一直非常热爱旅行，最终毅然离开金融行业，追寻创办一家旅行公司的梦想。

lines.en: For as long as I can remember, I wanted to be a travel writer. Before blogs existed and everything we read was online, I would go to travel writing seminars by writers who were published in travel magazines. I was desperate to write for one of those magazines, but didn't know how to break into that industry. After university, I ended up working in finance, but always had a desire to travel and write about it.
lines.zh: 从我记事起，我就想成为一名旅行作家。在博客尚未出现、我们阅读的所有内容都还是在线下的时候，我会参加由那些在旅行杂志上发表过作品的作家举办的旅行写作研讨会。我非常渴望为其中一本杂志撰稿，却不知道该如何进入那个行业。大学毕业后，我最终进入了金融行业工作，但始终渴望去旅行并写下旅行见闻。

lines.en: In 2015, I was looking at ways to leave finance, and my best friend Vanessa, who grew up on a ranch on the Central Coast of California, suggested starting a blog. But when we started creating it, we realized that was the same thing every girl was doing. So we turned our attention to creating a community among these women. This led us to start We Are Travel Girls, which has now grown into a community of over 200,000 followers.
lines.zh: 2015年，我正在寻找离开金融行业的方法，我最好的朋友 Vanessa 从小在加利福尼亚州中部海岸的一座牧场长大，她建议我们创办一个博客。但当我们开始创建博客时，我们意识到，这正是每个女孩都在做的事情。于是，我们把注意力转向在这些女性之间建立一个社区。这促使我们创办了 We Are Travel Girls，如今它已经发展成为一个拥有超过20万名关注者的社区。

lines.en: To anyone thinking about becoming a travel writer, I would suggest they first try and look for a unique way to enter the industry. There are a lot of travel writers now and it can be hard to stand out from the crowd, which is really why we started We Are Travel Girls. Be prepared to work hard if you want to turn it into a full-time business, and try not to rush to selling advertising spaces before you have created a dedicated audience. The size of your audience doesn't necessarily need to be huge, but you want them to be engaged. If you post too many promotions early on, you will turn many people off.
lines.zh: 对于任何考虑成为旅行作家的人，我建议他们首先尝试寻找一种独特的方式进入这个行业。如今旅行作家很多，要在人群中脱颖而出可能很难，这正是我们创办 We Are Travel Girls 的原因。若想把它发展成一项全职事业，就要做好努力工作的准备，并且在建立起一批忠实的受众之前，不要急于出售广告位。你的受众规模不一定要非常庞大，但你希望他们积极参与。如果一开始就发布太多推广内容，会让许多人失去兴趣。

analysis.替换: stick to the budget↔Keep to her budgetstick to = keep to

analysis.信号: 强否定动作 shut down + 理由。The bride quickly shut down the idea 里 shut down（直接否决）加上副词 quickly，语气强烈而干脆；后面 she did not want 的否定理由再次坐实拒绝。态度题就抓这种强否定动作 + 否定理由作为信号。
analysis.替换: quickly shut down the idea↔rejected it flatlyquickly shut down = rejected flatly
analysis.排除: A)与原文相反She called it romantic.（说它浪漫）是正面反应，与原文 shut down the idea 的干脆否决完全相反。原文里浪漫一词根本没出现，是凭"婚礼"联想出的诱选。 借用原文：The bride quickly shut down the idea B)与原文相反She welcomed it with open arms.（张开双臂欢迎）是强烈接受，恰与 Susan 的强烈拒绝相对。这是把态度光谱拨到了相反一端的干扰。 借用原文：quickly shut down the idea C)偷换概念She said she would think about it.（说她会考虑）是夹在接受与拒绝之间的中间态度，最像"温和版"答案。但原文是 quickly shut down——又快又决绝，没有任何"再想想"的余地。把强否定弱化成"考虑"，是程度偷改。 借用原文：The bride quickly shut down the idea

questions.stem: 【题目】 What has a new study revealed about temperature?
questions.stem_zh: 一项新研究揭示了关于温度的什么信息?

analysis.定位: P1 Now, a new study has provided evidence that temperature can influence people's personalities. 如今，一项新研究提供了证据，表明温度能够影响人的性格。
analysis.信号: Now 引出新结论。前一句说"天气影响情绪"早已是定论，紧接 Now, a new study has provided evidence 用 "Now"（如今）把新旧对照开来——"Now+新研究"正是答案信号，新研究的新发现就在这句，落点是 temperature can influence people's personalities。
analysis.替换: temperature can influence people's personalities↔It can influence people's personalities.近乎原句对应
analysis.排除: A)原词陷阱A"决定人的情绪 moods"盗用了原文 weather changes can affect people's moods 里的 moods，但那是"早已确立的旧定论"、且用的是 affect（影响）不是 determine（决定），并非"新研究的发现"，听到 moods 就选会掉进时间错位的坑。 借用原文：weather changes can affect people's moods B)未提及B 说温度"影响人的福祉 wellbeing"，可原文新研究讲的是影响"personalities 性格"，从没出现 wellbeing 这层；属凭"听着合理"硬填，原文无据。 C)答非所问C"与情绪密切相关 closely related to emotions"对应的是 weather changes can affect people's moods 那条"早已确立"的旧知识，不是"new study revealed"的新发现；既错在时间（旧非新），"closely"也夸大了原文 affect 的程度。 借用原文：It has long been scientifically established that weather changes can affect people's moods.

analysis.信号: 主语直点 warmer climates。这句主语就是题干路标词 Warmer climates，谓语 "make people feel more positive" 正面回答"温暖气候使人怎样"，是直接应答式的答案句，无需转折也无需推断。
analysis.替换: make people feel more positive in general↔They tend to produce positive feelings.使人感觉积极=产生积极感受
analysis.排除: A)未提及A"使人更能生育 reproductive"原文从未提及生育这一层，是凭"暖→繁衍"的常识硬推，无原文依据。 B)未提及B"延长寿命 life expectancy"听着像健康类结论，但原文谈温暖气候只说让人更积极、更友善，从未涉及寿命；属合理却无据。 D)张冠李戴D"逐渐改变人的基因 genes"盗用了原文 about 40% of a person's personality is determined by their genes 里的 genes，但原文 genes 是讲"基因决定四成性格"，根本不是说"温暖气候改变基因"；把别处的词安到本题对象上，是张冠李戴。 借用原文：about 40% of a person's personality is determined by their genes

questions.stem: 【题目】 Why does the speaker say the finding of a new national poll reveals a serious problem?
questions.stem_zh: 为什么说话者说一项新的全国民意调查的发现揭示了一个严重的问题?

analysis.定位: P2 This is a serious problem as research shows that chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens. 这是个严重的问题，因为研究显示长期的孤独对老年人尤其有害。
analysis.信号: 原句直说 serious problem 加 as 因果。录音里 This is a serious problem as research shows that chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens 用 a serious problem 直接呼应题干的 serious problem，再用 as（因为）引出原因——题干问 Why，答案就在这个 as 因果句里。
analysis.替换: chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens↔Chronic loneliness does harm to senior citizens in particular近义改写：harmful 换 does harm，particularly 换 in particular
analysis.排除: A)原词陷阱录音第1段确实念过 loneliness seems to be on the rise，选项 The number of older Americans living alone is on the rise 顺手借了 on the rise 制造耳熟，但录音说的是孤独在上升，不是独居老人人数在上升，且这不是题干问的为何是严重问题，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。 借用原文：loneliness seems to be on the rise C)原词陷阱第1段念过 correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions，选项 Correlations have been found between loneliness and ill health 借此造耳熟。但这是讲座开场的背景铺垫，题干问的是新民调揭示的严重问题，那条具体落在第2段的尤其伤害老人，C 答非所问。 借用原文：studies have long found correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions D)原词陷阱第2段念过 increasing their risk of early mortality，选项 A growing number of US seniors face the risk of early mortality 借走 early mortality 与 risk。但录音说的是长期孤独提高了老人早亡风险，并没说越来越多老人面临早亡风险（人数增长），D 把风险升高偷换成人数增多，答非所问。 借用原文：increasing their risk of early mortality

locate.en: This is a serious problem as research shows that chronic loneliness is particularly harmful to senior citizens.

passages.zh: 尽管这听起来难以想象，人类，每一个人，都有可能在未来某一天从地球上消失。我们已经学会担心小行星和超级火山，但据牛津大学哲学教授尼克·博斯特罗姆所说，更有可能出现的情形是我们人类将自我毁灭。

passages.en: Professor Bostrom, who directs Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute, has argued over the course of several papers that human __(27)__ risks are poorly understood and, worse still, __(28)__ underestimated by society. Some of these existential risks are fairly well known, especially the natural ones. But others are __(29)__ or even exotic. Most worrying to Bostrom is the subset of existential risks that __(30)__ from human technology, a subset that he expects to grow in number and potency over the next century.
passages.zh: 负责牛津大学人类未来研究所的博斯特罗姆教授在数篇论文中指出，人类灭绝的风险尚未得到充分理解；更糟糕的是，社会严重低估了这些风险。其中一些关乎人类存亡的风险相当为人所知，尤其是自然因素造成的风险。但另一些风险则鲜为人知，甚至十分异乎寻常。博斯特罗姆最为担忧的是那些源于人类技术的存亡风险；他预计，在未来一个世纪，这类风险的数量和威力都将不断增加。

passages.en: Despite his concerns about the risks __(31)__ to humans by technological progress, Bostrom is no luddite(科技进步反对者). In fact, he is a longtime __(32)__ of trans-humanism—the effort to improve the human condition, and even human nature itself, through technological means. In the long run he sees technology as a bridge, a bridge we humans must cross with great care, in order to reach new and better modes of being. In his work, Bostrom uses the tools of philosophy and mathematics, in __(33)__ , probability theory, to try and determine how we as a __(34)__ might achieve this safe passage. What follows is my conversation with Bostrom about some of the most interesting and worrying existential risks that humanity might __(35)__ in the decades and centuries to come, and about what we can do to make sure we outlast them.
passages.zh: 尽管担心技术进步给人类带来的风险，博斯特罗姆并不是科技进步反对者。事实上，他长期倡导超人类主义，即通过技术手段改善人类的处境，甚至改善人类自身的本性。从长远来看，他把技术视为一座桥梁，一座我们人类必须格外谨慎地跨越的桥梁，以便抵达全新且更好的存在方式。在他的研究中，博斯特罗姆运用哲学和数学工具，尤其是概率论，试图确定作为一个物种的我们该如何实现这种安全过渡。以下是我与博斯特罗姆的谈话，内容涉及未来数十年乃至数百年间人类可能遭遇的一些最有趣、也最令人担忧的存亡风险，以及我们能够采取哪些措施来确保自己比这些风险存在得更久。

wordbank.gloss: （名）倡导者、拥护者；（动）提倡、支持
出现、产生、兴起（不及物，常接 from）
强调（过去式/过去分词），被强调的
（形）模糊的、鲜为人知的；（动）使模糊
特别的；in particular = 尤其、特别地
（pose 的过去分词）造成、构成（威胁/风险）
情景、设想、可能发生的情况

rows.text: K) scenario名词
the more likely ___：形容词比较级后接单数名词作主语中心词
scenario = 可能发生的情景，对应"我们自我毁灭"这种假设性结局 the more likely __(26)__, … is that we humans will destroy ourselves：与小行星、超级火山"可能发生的情景"作比较，"可能性更大的情景"就是人类自毁，是 scenario 的典型用法（the more likely scenario is that…）。

F)evaporationevaporation 与上下文"灾难情景"无关 evaporation 指物理"蒸发"，无法与 asteroids、super volcanoes 这些"可能事件"作平行比较。 O)varietythe more likely variety 不构成自然搭配 variety 表"种类、多样性"，是分类词，不指向某个"具体可能事件"，与 is that 引导的同位语从句"具体事件"不匹配。
G) extinction名词
human ___ risks：两名词之间夹一空，作 noun adjunct 修饰 risks

human extinction risks = 人类灭绝风险，呼应全文 wiped from the face of the Earth 的主旨 首段 humanity, every last person, could someday be wiped from the face of the Earth 已把全文核心议题定为"人类灭绝"；human extinction risks 是该议题在学术语篇里的标准表达，与 human __(27)__ risks are poorly understood 中"被理解得很差"的对象完全吻合；extinction 作 noun adjunct 前置修饰 risks，语法上完全合法（参照 climate change risks 同类构造）。

E)essentialessential risks 语义模糊、不切主题 essential 意为"必不可少的"，essential risks 不构成有意义的表达，更无法对应下文反复出现的 existential risks（生存性风险）这一主题词。 F)evaporationhuman evaporation 与主题不符 evaporation 表"蒸发"，与 human 组合无主流学术意义，也不与下文"existential risks"形成对应。 H)obscureobscure 留给 29 题、且不修饰本句主语 下文 But others are __(29)__ or even exotic 才会用到"鲜为人知"这层意思；本句要刻画的是"人类面临的何种类别的风险被低估"，应是题材性限定（灭绝），而非性质性修饰（模糊）。 O)varietyhuman variety risks 不成立 variety 几乎只能用在 a variety of 结构中，无法作 noun adjunct 给 risks 加题材限定。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 E) —— essential risks 听着像"关键风险"很诱人。human __(27)__ risks are poorly understood 处若只看本句、不回主旨，很容易误选 essential"本质风险"；防坑：始终回到首段 humanity, every last person, could someday be wiped from the face of the Earth 这句话定题材，与 extinction 一一对应。
L) severely副词
worse still, ___ underestimated：修饰过去分词 underestimated

severely underestimated = 被严重低估，与 poorly understood 程度副词平行 poorly understood and, worse still, __(28)__ underestimated by society：前后并列结构，副词位都修饰被动分词，描述"理解不充分"与"低估"的负面程度；severely 与 poorly 同色调、加重语气，呼应 worse still。
M)shrewdlyshrewdly 是褒义"精明地"，与 underestimated 的负面语境冲突 shrewdly underestimated 等于说"精明地低估了"，自相矛盾，且与 worse still 表示的"更糟"色调相反。
最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— shrewdly 与 severely 都是副词，词性对、易混。worse still, __(28)__ underestimated by society 处考生若只卡词性、不看色调，可能误选 shrewdly；防坑：紧盯 worse still 这一句间连接词，色调一负到底。
H) obscure形容词
others are ___ or even exotic：系动词 are 后接形容词作表语

obscure 与 exotic 同色调：鲜为人知 → 甚至怪异 But others are __(29)__ or even exotic 与上句 Some of these existential risks are fairly well known 形成"有些众所周知，但另一些则……"的转折；空处需与 "well known" 反义，与 exotic 同向，先"鲜为人知"再"怪异"层层递进，正是 obscure。
E)essentialessential 与 exotic 不同色、且与 well known 不构成反义 essential 意为"本质的、必要的"，既无法与 exotic 形成程度递进，也无法与上句 well known 构成转折，逻辑链断裂。
B) arise动词
risks that ___ from：that 引导的定语从句中作谓语，后接 from
arise from = 源自、由……产生，对应"来自人类技术的风险" the subset of existential risks that __(30)__ from human technology 表达"源自人类技术的那一类生存风险"，arise from 是英语描述"源自/由……引起"的固定搭配，与主语 risks 复数原形相配。
J) posed动词
risks ___ to humans by …：名词后接非谓语作后置定语

pose a risk to sb by sth = 由某物对某人造成风险 the risks __(31)__ to humans by technological progress：pose 与 risk/threat/challenge 是英语里"造成……威胁/风险"的强搭配，且 to humans 与 by technological progress 分别充当 pose 的间接宾语方向与施事，被动式 posed 一招到位。
C)emphasizedemphasize 与 risk 不构成"造成风险"的语义 emphasize 意为"强调"，emphasized to humans by 表达不出"由技术进步带给人类的风险"的因果关系；且 risks emphasized to humans 在逻辑上与"Bostrom 担忧技术造成的风险"主线偏离。
A) advocate名词
a longtime ___ of：a 后接单数可数名词，of 引出对象

an advocate of X = X 的倡导者，与上下文呼应 he is a longtime __(32)__ of trans-humanism—the effort to improve the human condition…through technological means，前句 Bostrom is no luddite 说他不是科技进步反对者，正面身份就是"长期倡导者"，an advocate of trans-humanism 是固定搭配。

D)encounterencounter 作名词义为"遭遇"，不指人 a longtime encounter of trans-humanism = "超人类主义的一段长期遭遇"，既不指人也无法被 of 紧跟一个学说作宾语，与前句"他不是反对者"的逻辑承接不上。 F)evaporationevaporation 是物理过程词、不指人 evaporation of trans-humanism 无意义，且无法承接"he is"的身份判定。 O)varietya longtime variety of … 不指人，逻辑也不通 variety of 通常表"……的多种类型"，无法与 he is 构成身份关系。
I) particular形容词
in ___ 介词后接名词或形容词，与 in particular 构成固定短语
in particular = 尤其，引出后面的具体例子 probability theory in __(33)__, probability theory 后半段对前半句 the tools of philosophy and mathematics 中的 mathematics 作"尤其是"的细化举例，正是 in particular 的典型用法。

E)essentialin essential 不是英语固定搭配 essential 意为"本质的"，常说 in essence（本质上）而非 in essential；放进 in __(33)__, probability theory 既无搭配支撑、语义上也不能引出举例。 H)obscurein obscure 不成搭配且语义反向 obscure 是"模糊/鲜为人知的"，在此既无固定短语，也与 Bostrom"明确使用概率论"的语境冲突。
N) species名词
we as a ___：as a 后接单数可数名词，we 的同位

we as a species = 我们作为一个物种，与全文"人类整体存亡"主旨严丝合缝 how we as a __(34)__ might achieve this safe passage 的语境是讨论"人类作为一个整体如何安全跨越技术之桥"，species（物种）正是把"全人类"集合化的标准学术用语，与首段 humanity, every last person 的视角一致。species 单复数同形，符合 as a 单数要求。

F)evaporationevaporation 是"蒸发"，不能作 we 的同位身份 evaporation 描述物理/抽象过程，与"我们作为一个 X"的身份位完全不搭。 K)scenarioscenario 留给 26 题且语义不通 scenario 是"情景"，we as a scenario 不构成意义；并且 26 题（the more likely ___）正是为 scenario 量身定做的位置。 O)varietywe as a variety 不成立 variety 指"多样性、种类"，搭配上多说 a variety of，无法独立作 we 的身份同位；且 a variety 在此既无具体所指也偏离主题。
D) encounter动词
humanity might ___：情态动词 might 后接动词原形
encounter risks = 遭遇风险，是及物动词，宾语正是先行词 risks existential risks that humanity might __(35)__ in the decades and centuries to come 中，空是定语从句的谓语动词、需要及物动词以"risks"为宾语；encounter 正是"遭遇/碰到（风险/困难）"的标准搭配。
B)arisearise 是不及物动词，不能直接带宾语 risks arise 意为"产生、出现"，是不及物动词（risks arise，而不是 humanity arise risks）；放进"humanity might arise risks"语法立刻不成立。

longreading.title: 2023年3月·第1套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) The fog still chills the morning air and the cable cars still climb halfway to the stars. Yet on the ground, the Bay area has changed greatly since singer Tony Bennett left his heart here. Silicon Valley and the tech industry have led the region into a period of unprecedented wealth and innovation. But existing political and land limits have caused an alarming housing crisis and astronomical rise in social and economic difference.
passages.zh: 雾气依旧使清晨的空气透着寒意，缆车依旧向着星空攀升至半山腰。然而在地面上，自歌手托尼·贝内特将心留在这里以来，旧金山湾区已经发生了巨大的变化。硅谷和科技产业带领这一地区进入了一个财富与创新前所未有的时期。但现有的政治和土地限制引发了令人担忧的住房危机，也造成了社会和经济差距的天文式增长。

passages.en: B) While the residents of most cities display pride and support for their home industries, drastic market distortions in the San Francisco Bay Area have created boiling resentment in the region towards the tech industry. A vocal minority is even calling on officials to punish those who are benefitting from the economic and housing boom. If this boom and its consequences are not resolved, a drastic increase in social and economic difference may have a profound impact on the region for generations. A history and analysis of this transformation may hold invaluable insights about the opportunities. Perils of tech cities are currently being cultivated across the US, and indeed around the world.
passages.zh: 虽然大多数城市的居民都会表现出对本地产业的自豪和支持，但旧金山湾区严重的市场扭曲已经在该地区引发了对科技产业沸腾般的怨恨。甚至有一小部分积极发声的人呼吁官员惩罚那些从经济和住房繁荣中获益的人。如果这场繁荣及其后果得不到解决，社会和经济差距的大幅扩大可能会对该地区数代人产生深远影响。对这一转变的历史和分析，或许能为目前正在美国乃至世界各地培育的科技城市所面临的机遇与危险提供极其宝贵的启示。

passages.en: C) According to a recent study, San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference. The average income of the top 1% of households in the city averages $3.6 million. This is 44 times the average income of those at the bottom, which stands at $81,094. The top 1% of the San Francisco peninsula's share of total income now extends to 30.8% of the region's income. This was a dramatic jump from 1989, where it stood at 15.8%.
passages.zh: 根据一项近期研究，旧金山的经济差距在加利福尼亚州位居首位。该市收入最高的1%家庭的平均收入为360万美元。这是收入最低人群平均收入的44倍，后者为81,094美元。如今，旧金山半岛收入最高的1%人口所占的总收入份额已达到该地区收入的30.8%。与1989年的15.8%相比，这是一次巨大的跃升。

passages.en: D) The region's economy has been fundamentally transformed by the technology industry springing from Silicon Valley. Policies pushed by Mayor Ed Lee provided tax breaks for tech companies to set up shop along the city's long-neglected Mid-Market area. The city is now home to Twitter, Uber, Airbnb, Pinterest, Dropbox and others. In short, the Bay Area has become a global magnet for those with specialized skills, which has in turn helped fuel economic enthusiasm, and this economic growth has reduced unemployment to 3.4%, an admirable feat.
passages.zh: 从硅谷兴起的科技产业从根本上改变了该地区的经济。市长埃德·李推动的政策为科技公司提供税收优惠，吸引它们在城市长期被忽视的市场街中段沿线设立办公地点。如今，推特、优步、爱彼迎、Pinterest、Dropbox等公司都坐落于此。简而言之，湾区已经成为拥有专业技能的人才的全球磁石，这反过来又助推了经济热情；而这种经济增长将失业率降至3.4%，这是一项令人钦佩的成就。

passages.en: E) In spite of all that, the strength of the recent job growth, combined with policies that have traditionally limited housing development in the city and throughout the peninsula, did not help ease the affordability crisis. In 2015 alone, the Bay Area added 64,000 in jobs. In the same year, only 5,000 new homes were built.
passages.zh: 尽管如此，近期强劲的就业增长，加上市内及整个半岛历来限制住房开发的政策，并未帮助缓解住房负担能力危机。仅在2015年，湾区就增加了64,000个就业岗位。同年，新建住房却只有5,000套。

passages.en: F) With the average house in the city costing over $1.25 million and average flat prices over $1.11 million, the minimum qualifying income to purchase a house has increased to $254,000. Considering that the average household income in the city currently stands at around $80,000, it is not an exaggeration to say that the dream of home ownership is now beyond the grasp of the vast majority of today's people who rent.
passages.zh: 由于该市住房的平均价格超过125万美元，公寓的平均价格超过111万美元，购买住房所需的最低收入已升至254,000美元。考虑到该市目前的平均家庭收入约为80,000美元，说如今绝大多数租房者已经无法实现拥有住房的梦想，并不夸张。

passages.en: G) For generations, the stability and prosperity of the American middle class have been anchored by home ownership. Studies have consistently shown that the value of land has overtaken overall income growth, thus providing a huge advantage to property owners as a vehicle of wealth building. When home prices soar above the reach of most households, the gap between the rich and the poor dramatically increases.
passages.zh: 几代以来，住房所有权一直是美国中产阶级稳定与繁荣的根基。研究一再表明，土地价值的增长已经超过总体收入的增长，从而使房产所有者在通过房产积累财富方面获得了巨大优势。当房价飙升至大多数家庭难以企及的水平时，贫富差距就会显著扩大。

passages.en: H) If contributing factors leading to housing becoming less than affordable are not resolved over multiple generations, a small elite will control a vast share of the country's total wealth. The result? A society where the threat of class warfare would loom large. A society's level of happiness is tied less to measures of quantitative wealth and more to measures of qualitative wealth. This means that how a person judges their security in comparison to their neighbors' has more of an impact on their happiness than their objective standard of living. At the same time, when a system no longer provides opportunities for the majority to participate in wealth building, it not only robs those who are excluded from opportunities, but also deprives them of their dignity.
passages.zh: 如果导致住房变得难以负担的各种因素在数代人的时间里得不到解决，那么一小部分精英将控制全国总财富中的巨大份额。结果会怎样？社会将笼罩在阶级斗争威胁之下。一个社会的幸福程度，与其说取决于对数量财富的衡量，不如说更多取决于对质量财富的衡量。这意味着，一个人如何将自己的安全感与邻居进行比较，对其幸福感的影响，要大于其客观生活水平。同时，当一个制度不再为大多数人提供参与财富积累的机会时，它不仅剥夺了那些被排除在机会之外的人，也使他们失去了尊严。

passages.en: I) San Francisco and the Bay Area have long been committed to values which embrace inclusion and rejection of mainstream culture. To see these values coming apart so publicly adds insult to injury for a region once defined by its progressive social fabric. In the face of resentment, it is human to want revenge. But deteriorating policies such as heavily taxing technology companies or real estate developers are not likely to shift the balance.
passages.zh: 旧金山和湾区长期以来一直致力于拥抱包容、拒绝主流文化的价值观。对于一个曾以进步的社会结构为特征的地区来说，眼看这些价值观如此公开地分崩离析，无疑是雪上加霜。面对怨恨，人们想要报复是人之常情。但对科技公司或房地产开发商征收重税等日益恶化的政策，不太可能改变这种失衡状态。

passages.en: J) The housing crisis is caused by two primary factors: the growing desirability of the Bay Area as a place to live due to its excellent economy, and our limited housing stock. Although the city is experiencing an unprecedented boom in new housing, more units are sorely needed. Protection policies were originally designed to suppress bad development and boost historic preservation in our urban areas. Now, too many developers are experiencing excessive delays. Meanwhile, there are the land limitations of the Bay Area to consider. The region is surrounded by water and mountains. Local governments need to aid development as well. This means increasing housing density throughout the region and building upwards while streamlining the approval process.
passages.zh: 住房危机由两个主要因素造成：由于经济状况优越，湾区作为居住地越来越受欢迎；以及我们的住房存量有限。尽管该市正在经历新住房建设前所未有的繁荣，但仍迫切需要更多住房单元。保护性政策最初旨在遏制不良开发，并加强城市地区的历史保护。如今，太多开发商正经历过度延误。同时，还必须考虑湾区的土地限制。该地区四面环水、群山环绕。地方政府也需要助力开发。这意味着要提高整个地区的住房密度，向上建设，同时简化审批流程。

passages.en: K) Real estate alone will not solve the problem, of course. Transportation, too, needs to be updated and infrastructure extended to link distant regions to Silicon Valley and the city. We need to build an effective high-speed commuting system linking the high-priced and crowded Bay Area with the low-priced and low-density Central Valley. This would dramatically reduce travel times. And based on the operating speeds of hovering trains used in countries such as Japan or Spain, high-speed rail could shorten the time to travel between San Francisco and California's capital, Sacramento, or from Stockton to San Jose, to under 30 minutes. This system would bring once distant regions within reasonable commute to heavy job centers. The city also needs to update existing transportation routes combined with smart home-building policies that dramatically increase housing density in areas surrounding high-speed rail stations. By doing so, we will be able to build affordable housing within acceptable commuting distances for a significant bulk of the workforce.
passages.zh: 当然，仅靠房地产无法解决这一问题。交通也需要更新，基础设施也需要扩建，以便将偏远地区与硅谷和旧金山市连接起来。我们需要建设一套高效的高速通勤系统，将房价高昂且人口拥挤的湾区与房价低廉、人口密度较低的中央谷地连接起来。这将大幅缩短出行时间。根据日本或西班牙等国家所使用的磁悬浮列车的运行速度，高速铁路可以将旧金山与加利福尼亚州首府萨克拉门托之间，或斯托克顿与圣何塞之间的通行时间缩短至30分钟以内。这一系统将使曾经遥远的地区进入主要就业中心的合理通勤范围之内。该市还需要更新现有的交通线路，并结合明智的住房建设政策，大幅提高高速铁路车站周边地区的住房密度。这样一来，我们就能够在可接受的通勤距离内，为相当大一部分劳动力建设可负担住房。

passages.en: L) Our threatening housing crisis forces the difficult question of what type of society we would like to be. Will it be one where the elite command the vast bulk of wealth and regional culture is defined by an aggressive business world? We were recently treated to a taste of the latter, when local tech employee Justin Keller wrote an open letter to the city complaining about having to see homeless people on his way to work.
passages.zh: 迫在眉睫的住房危机迫使我们面对一个艰难的问题：我们希望成为什么样的社会？我们是否会成为这样一种社会：精英掌控绝大部分财富，而地区文化由一个咄咄逼人的商业世界所定义？最近，当当地科技从业者贾斯汀·凯勒写公开信向市政府抱怨自己上班途中不得不看到无家可归者时，我们就见识到了后一种情形的一斑。

passages.en: M) It doesn't have to be this way. But solutions need to be implemented now, before angry crowds grow from a nuisance to serious concern. It may take less than you might think. And in fact, the solutions to our housing crisis are already fairly clear. We need to increase the density of housing units. We need to use existing technology to shorten travel times and break the land limits. There is a way to solve complex social and economic problems without abandoning social responsibility. This is the Bay Area's opportunity to prove that it can innovate more than just technology.
passages.zh: 事情不一定非要如此。但我们必须立即实施解决方案，以免愤怒的人群从令人讨厌的麻烦发展成严重的问题。所需时间可能比你想象的更短。事实上，住房危机的解决方案已经相当明确。我们需要提高住房单元的密度。我们需要利用现有技术缩短出行时间，突破土地限制。在不放弃社会责任的前提下，解决复杂的社会和经济问题是有可能的。这是湾区证明自己不仅能够创新科技，也能够创新其他领域的机会。

statements.en: The higher rate of employment, combined with limited housing supply, did not make it any easier to buy a house.
statements.zh: 较高的就业率加上有限的住房供应,并没有使购房变得更加容易。

analysis.锚点: 就业 + 供房不足却没让买房更易
analysis.定位: E 段 In spite of all that, the strength of the recent job growth, combined with policies that have traditionally limited housing development in the city and throughout the peninsula, did not help ease the affordability crisis. 尽管如此，近期就业增长的强劲势头，叠加传统上限制本市及整个半岛住房开发的政策，并没有帮助缓解可负担危机。

analysis.辨邻: F F 段算的是 the minimum qualifying income to purchase a house has increased to $254,000 与 the average household income in the city currently stands at around $80,000 的差距，结论与买房难有关，但没有 higher rate of employment 这条原因要素，因此不是本题来源。 the minimum qualifying income to purchase a house has increased to $254,000

statements.en: One way to deal with the housing crisis is for the government to simplify approval procedures for housing projects.
statements.zh: 应对住房危机的一种方法是政府简化住房项目的审批程序。

analysis.锚点: 政府简化住房项目审批
analysis.定位: J 段 This means increasing housing density throughout the region and building upwards while streamlining the approval process. 这意味着要在整个地区提高住房密度、向上建造，同时精简审批流程。
analysis.改写: simplify approval procedures for housing projects↔streamlining the approval process streamline = simplify，process = procedures
analysis.辨邻: M M 段重在 We need to increase the density of housing units 与 use existing technology to shorten travel times and break the land limits 等动作，未出现 approval 关联词，因此不是本题来源段。 the solutions to our housing crisis are already fairly clear

statements.en: Residents of the San Francisco Bay Area strongly resent the tech industry because of the economic inequality it has contributed to.
statements.zh: San Francisco湾区的居民因科技行业造成的经济不平等而强烈不满。

analysis.锚点: 居民因贫富差距强烈憎恨科技业
analysis.定位: B 段 While the residents of most cities display pride and support for their home industries, drastic market distortions in the San Francisco Bay Area have created boiling resentment in the region towards the tech industry. 尽管大多数城市的居民都为本地产业感到自豪并予以支持，旧金山湾区却因剧烈的市场扭曲，对科技业产生了强烈的怨气。
analysis.改写: strongly resent the tech industry↔boiling resentment in the region towards the tech industry 动词 resent 与名词 resentment 同根；strongly = boiling because of the economic inequality it has contributed to↔drastic market distortions in the San Francisco Bay Area have created boiling resentment 市场扭曲 = 经济不平等的具体表现
analysis.辨邻: I I 段 In the face of resentment, it is human to want revenge 是对已有怨气的回应，没有把“怨气 → 科技业 → 经济不平等”这条归因链给出。 In the face of resentment, it is human to want revenge

statements.en: The fast rise in the prices of land and houses increases the economic inequality among people.
statements.zh: 土地和房屋价格的快速上涨加剧了人们之间的经济不平等。

analysis.锚点: 地价/房价飙升扩大经济差距
analysis.定位: G 段 When home prices soar above the reach of most households, the gap between the rich and the poor dramatically increases. 当房价飙升至大多数家庭难以企及时，贫富差距就会急剧扩大。
analysis.改写: fast rise in the prices of land and houses↔When home prices soar above the reach of most households fast rise = soar increases the economic inequality among people↔the gap between the rich and the poor dramatically increases 经济不平等 = 贫富差距
analysis.辨邻: C C 段聚焦 San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference 与 The average income of the top 1% of households in the city averages $3.6 million 等收入差距数字，没有把“房价/地价上升”作为原因引入。 San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference H H 段 If contributing factors leading to housing becoming less than affordable are not resolved over multiple generations, a small elite will control a vast share of the country's total wealth 是远期社会后果论，与陈述句要的直接因果不同。 a small elite will control a vast share of the country's total wealth

statements.en: San Francisco city government offered tax benefits to attract tech companies to establish operations in a less developed area.
statements.zh: San Francisco市政府提供税收优惠以吸引科技公司在欠发达地区开展业务。

analysis.锚点: 市政府用税收优惠引科技公司去欠发达区
analysis.定位: D 段 Policies pushed by Mayor Ed Lee provided tax breaks for tech companies to set up shop along the city's long-neglected Mid-Market area. 由市长 Ed Lee 推动的政策为科技公司提供税收减免，让它们在该市长期被忽视的 Mid-Market 区域开设业务。
analysis.改写: offered tax benefits↔provided tax breaks offered = provided，benefits = breaks to attract tech companies to establish operations↔for tech companies to set up shop to attract ... to establish = for ... to set up shop in a less developed area↔along the city's long-neglected Mid-Market area less developed = long-neglected
analysis.辨邻: I I 段 deteriorating policies such as heavily taxing technology companies or real estate developers 描述的是与本题相反的政策方向，且语境是“不要这么做”。看到 tax 就选会被“正话反说”诱导。 deteriorating policies such as heavily taxing technology companies

statements.en: Innovative solutions to social and economic problems should be introduced before it is too late.
statements.zh: 应在为时已晚之前引入社会和经济问题的创新解决方案。

analysis.定位: M 段 But solutions need to be implemented now, before angry crowds grow from a nuisance to serious concern. 但解决方案必须立刻实施，趁愤怒的人群还没从小麻烦发展成严重问题。
analysis.改写: Innovative solutions to social and economic problems↔a way to solve complex social and economic problems without abandoning social responsibility social and economic problems 原词复现，Innovative ↔ innovate 同根 before it is too late↔solutions need to be implemented now, before angry crowds grow from a nuisance to serious concern now + before sth gets worse = before it is too late
analysis.辨邻: J J 段更像问题剖析与对策列举；陈述句“创新解法 + 趁早”是宏观呼吁，与 M 段的尾段定位匹配。 increasing housing density throughout the region and building upwards while streamlining the approval process K K 段聚焦 high-speed commuting system 这一具体方案，无 before it is too late 这种时间紧迫性表述。 Transportation, too, needs to be updated and infrastructure extended to link distant regions to Silicon Valley and the city

statements.en: When people compare their own living standard with others', it has a greater impact on their sense of contentment.
statements.zh: 当人们将自己的生活水平与他人进行比较时,这对他们的满足感有更大的影响。

analysis.锚点: 和别人比较影响幸福感
analysis.定位: H 段 This means that how a person judges their security in comparison to their neighbors' has more of an impact on their happiness than their objective standard of living. 这意味着，一个人如何与邻居比较自己的安全感，对其幸福感的影响要大于他客观的生活水平。
analysis.改写: compare their own living standard with others'↔how a person judges their security in comparison to their neighbors' compare with others' = in comparison to neighbors' it has a greater impact on their sense of contentment↔has more of an impact on their happiness than their objective standard of living sense of contentment = happiness; greater impact = more of an impact
analysis.辨邻: G G 段 When home prices soar above the reach of most households, the gap between the rich and the poor dramatically increases 是经济差距视角，缺少“幸福感/满足感”这层。 the gap between the rich and the poor dramatically increases

statements.en: San Francisco has been found to have the biggest income gap in California between the rich and the poor.
statements.zh: San Francisco被发现是加利福尼亚州贫富收入差距最大的城市。

analysis.锚点: 加州贫富差距最大的城市
analysis.定位: C 段 According to a recent study, San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference. 根据最近的一项研究，旧金山在加州的经济差距方面排名第一。
analysis.改写: biggest income gap in California↔San Francisco ranks first in California for economic difference ranks first = biggest，economic difference = income gap between the rich and the poor↔The average income of the top 1% of households in the city averages $3.6 million. This is 44 times the average income of those at the bottom top 1% vs those at the bottom = rich vs poor

statements.en: Improved transport networks connecting the city to distant outlying areas will also help solve the housing crisis.
statements.zh: 连接城市与遥远边缘地区的改善交通网络也将有助于解决住房危机。

analysis.锚点: 改善交通连接远郊缓解住房危机
analysis.定位: K 段 Transportation, too, needs to be updated and infrastructure extended to link distant regions to Silicon Valley and the city. 交通也需要升级，基础设施需要延伸，把远郊与硅谷及本市连接起来。
analysis.改写: Improved transport networks↔Transportation, too, needs to be updated and infrastructure extended Improved = updated + extended connecting the city to distant outlying areas↔link distant regions to Silicon Valley and the city connect = link，distant outlying areas = distant regions will also help solve the housing crisis↔we will be able to build affordable housing within acceptable commuting distances for a significant bulk of the workforce 建可负担住房 = 帮助解决住房危机

statements.en: Average incomes in the Bay Area make it virtually impossible for most tenant families to buy a home.
statements.zh: 湾区的平均收入使得大多数租户家庭几乎不可能购买住房。

analysis.锚点: 平均收入让大多数租户买不起房
analysis.定位: F 段 Considering that the average household income in the city currently stands at around $80,000, it is not an exaggeration to say that the dream of home ownership is now beyond the grasp of the vast majority of today's people who rent. 考虑到该市目前家庭平均收入约 8 万美元，说“如今对绝大多数租户而言，拥有住房的梦想已遥不可及”并不夸张。
analysis.改写: Average incomes in the Bay Area↔the average household income in the city currently stands at around $80,000 平均收入两端同义 virtually impossible for most tenant families to buy a home↔the dream of home ownership is now beyond the grasp of the vast majority of today's people who rent beyond the grasp = virtually impossible；people who rent = tenant families

passages.en: The ability to make inferences from same and different, once thought to be unique to humans, is viewed as a cornerstone of abstract intelligent thought. A new study, however, has shown that what psychologists call same-different discrimination is present in creatures generally seen as unintelligent: newborn ducklings(小鸭).
passages.zh: 从相同与不同中进行推断的能力曾被认为是人类独有的能力，被视为抽象智能思维的基石。然而，一项新研究表明，心理学家所称的相同—不同辨别能力也存在于通常被认为并不聪明的生物身上：刚出生的小鸭。

passages.en: The study, published Thursday in Science, challenges our idea of what it means to have a birdbrain, said Edward Wasserman, an experimental psychologist at the University of Iowa who wrote an independent review of the study.
passages.zh: 爱荷华大学实验心理学家Edward Wasserman为这项研究撰写了独立评论。他说，这项于周四发表在《科学》杂志上的研究，挑战了我们对拥有“鸟脑”意味着什么的认识。

passages.en: "In fact, birds are extremely intelligent and our problem pretty much lies in figuring out how to get them to 'talk' to us, or tell us how smart they really are," he said.
passages.zh: 他说：“事实上，鸟类极其聪明，而我们的问题基本在于如何让它们‘与我们交谈’，或者告诉我们它们究竟有多聪明。”

passages.en: Antone Martinho and Alex Kacelnik, co-authors of the new paper, devised a clever experiment to better test bird intelligence.
passages.zh: 新论文的共同作者Antone Martinho和Alex Kacelnik设计了一项巧妙的实验，以更好地检验鸟类的智力。

passages.en: First, they took 1-day-old ducklings and exposed them to a pair of moving objects. The two objects were either the same or different in shape or color. Then they exposed each duckling to two entirely new pairs of moving objects.
passages.zh: 首先，他们将一日龄的小鸭置于一对运动物体前。这两个物体的形状或颜色要么相同，要么不同。随后，他们又让每只小鸭观察两对全新的运动物体。

passages.en: The researchers found that about 70% of the ducklings preferred to move toward the pair of objects that had the same shape or color relationship as the first objects they saw. A duckling that was first shown two green spheres, in other words, was more likely to move toward a pair of blue spheres than a mismatched pair of orange and purple spheres.
passages.zh: 研究人员发现，大约70%的小鸭更喜欢朝着这样一对物体移动：这对物体与它们最初看到的物体之间具有相同的形状或颜色关系。换句话说，一只最初看到两个绿色球体的小鸭，更有可能朝着一对蓝色球体移动，而不是朝着一对由橙色和紫色球体组成的不匹配物体移动。

passages.en: Ducklings go through a rapid learning process called imprinting shortly after birth—it's what allows them to identify and follow their mothers.
passages.zh: 小鸭出生后不久会经历一个称为印刻的快速学习过程，这一过程使它们能够辨认并跟随自己的母亲。

passages.en: These findings suggest that ducklings use abstract relationships between sensory inputs like color, shape, sounds and odor to recognize their mothers, said Dr. Kacelnik.
passages.zh: Kacelnik博士说，这些发现表明，小鸭利用颜色、形状、声音和气味等感官输入之间的抽象关系来辨认自己的母亲。

passages.en: By studying imprinting, the authors of this study have shown for the first time that an animal can learn relationships between concepts without training, said Jeffrey Katz, an experimental psychologist at Auburn University who was not involved in the study.
passages.zh: 奥本大学实验心理学家Jeffrey Katz没有参与这项研究。他说，通过研究印刻，这项研究的作者首次证明，动物能够在没有训练的情况下学习概念之间的关系。

passages.en: Previous studies have suggested that other animals, including pigeons, dolphins, honeybees and some primates(灵长类动物), can discern same from different, but only after extensive training.
passages.zh: 此前的研究表明，包括鸽子、海豚、蜜蜂和某些灵长类动物在内的其他动物也能辨别相同与不同，但这只有在经过大量训练之后才能做到。

passages.en: Adding ducklings to the list—particularly untrained newborn ducklings—suggests that the ability to compare abstract concepts "is far more necessary to a wider variety of animals' survival than we previously thought," Dr. Martinho said. He believes the ability is so crucial because it helps animals consider context when identifying objects in their environment.
passages.zh: Martinho博士说，将小鸭，尤其是未经训练的初生小鸭，加入这一名单表明，比较抽象概念的能力“对于更多种类动物的生存而言，比我们此前认为的更加必要”。他认为，这种能力至关重要，因为它能帮助动物在辨认周围环境中的物体时考虑情境。

passages.en: It's clear from this study and others like it that "animals process and appreciate far more of the intricacies in their world than we've ever understood," Dr. Wasserman said. "We are in a revolutionary phase in terms of our ability to understand the minds of other animals."
passages.zh: Wasserman博士说，从这项研究以及其他类似研究中可以清楚看出，“动物处理和理解其世界复杂性的程度，远远超过我们以往的认识。”“就我们理解其他动物心智的能力而言，我们正处于一个革命性阶段。”

questions.stem: In what way were humans thought to be unique?
questions.stem_zh: 人类曾被认为在哪方面具有独特性?

options.text: Being a major source of animal intelligence.
options.zh: 作为动物智能的主要来源。

options.text: Being the cornerstone of the creative world.
options.zh: 作为创造性世界的基石。

options.text: Being capable of same-different discrimination.
options.zh: 能够进行相同-不同辨别。

options.text: Being able to distinguish abstract from concrete.
options.zh: 能够区分抽象与具体。

questions.判型: In what way were humans thought to be unique? 是 in what way 引导的客观信息问句，对应原文一句话即可回答。
questions.拆句: Q46 是一个被动语态的疑问句，主干是 humans were thought to be unique，were thought 是过去时被动，提示这一观点是过去的传统看法（呼应原文 once thought to be unique to humans 中的 once）。in what way 问的是 unique 的具体维度。
questions.定位: P1 The ability to make inferences from same and different, once thought to be unique to humans, is viewed as a cornerstone of abstract intelligent thought. 曾被认为是人类独有的、对 "同" 与 "异" 进行推断的能力，被视为抽象智力思维的基石。

locate.en: The ability to make inferences from same and different, once thought to be unique to humans, is viewed as a cornerstone of abstract intelligent thought.
locate.zh: 曾被认为是人类独有的、对 "同" 与 "异" 进行推断的能力，被视为抽象智力思维的基石。

option_analysis.note: 选项 Being a major source of animal intelligence 说人类是 "动物智力的主要来源"，原文从未提出这一观点；文章只对比人与动物的智力，没说人是动物智力的源头。
cornerstone of abstract intelligent thought 修饰的是 "同/异推断能力"，是 "抽象智力的基石"，不是 "创造性世界的基石"；选项 Being the cornerstone of the creative world 把对象偷换成 the creative world。
预判 "人类独有的是 same-different 推断能力"，C 选项 Being capable of same-different discrimination 把这一信息完整还原，且来源于原文同一句话，是定位句的标准同义改写。

pairs.orig: make inferences from same and different
once thought to be unique to humans

option_analysis.note: 原文只提及 abstract intelligent thought，从未提及 concrete 这一概念；选项 Being able to distinguish abstract from concrete 把抽象与具体编造成可区分的对象。

questions.stem: What do we learn from the study published in Science?
questions.stem_zh: 我们从发表在《科学》杂志上的研究中了解到什么?

options.text: Our understanding of the bird world was biased.
options.zh: 我们对鸟类世界的理解存在偏见。

options.text: Our conception of birds' intelligence was wrong.
options.zh: 我们对鸟类智能的概念是错误的。

options.text: Our communication with birds was far from adequate.
options.zh: 我们与鸟类的交流远远不够充分。

options.text: Our knowledge about bird psychology needs updating.
options.zh: 我们关于鸟类心理学的知识需要更新。

questions.判型: What do we learn from the study published in Science? 限定了来源，问该研究告诉我们什么客观结论，对应原文该研究的总评句。
questions.拆句: 题干主干是 What do we learn from the study；过去分词短语 published in Science 后置修饰 the study，相当于定语从句 which was published in Science，用来锁定具体哪一项研究。

questions.stem: What did the researchers discover about most ducklings from their experiment?
questions.stem_zh: 研究人员从实验中发现大多数雏鸭有什么特点?

options.text: They could associate shape with color.
options.zh: 它们能够将形状与颜色联系起来。

options.text: They reacted quickly to moving objects.
options.zh: 它们对移动物体反应迅速。

options.zh: 它们更喜欢有色物体而不是无色物体。

options.text: They could tell whether the objects were the same.
options.zh: 它们能够判断物体是否相同。

questions.判型: What did the researchers discover about most ducklings from their experiment? 直接问研究者发现了什么，是对实验结果的客观提问。
questions.拆句: 主干是 What did the researchers discover；about most ducklings 是 discover 的内容限定，from their experiment 是来源状语。整句无陷阱，按 "实验 → 发现 → 关于多数小鸭的结论" 这一链条去原文找即可。
questions.定位: P6 The researchers found that about 70% of the ducklings preferred to move toward the pair of objects that had the same shape or color relationship as the first objects they saw. 研究者发现，约 70% 的小鸭更倾向于走向与它们第一次看到的物体保持同种形状或颜色关系的那一对物体。

locate.en: The researchers found that about 70% of the ducklings preferred to move toward the pair of objects that had the same shape or color relationship as the first objects they saw.
locate.zh: 研究者发现，约 70% 的小鸭更倾向于走向与它们第一次看到的物体保持同种形状或颜色关系的那一对物体。

option_analysis.note: 原文是 the same shape or color relationship——这里 or 表示 "形状或颜色" 二者之一的关系，不是把形状和颜色 "关联起来"；选项 They could associate shape with color 是错读 or 的产物。

预判 "小鸭能识别同异关系"，They could tell whether the objects were the same 与之精确对应；tell whether X were the same 正是 same-different discrimination 的口语化表述。

questions.stem: What was novel about the experiment in the study reported in Science?
questions.stem_zh: 《科学》杂志报道的研究中,该实验的新颖之处是什么?

options.text: The animals used received no training.

questions.判型: What was novel about the experiment...? 问该实验本身新颖在哪里，是对实验属性的客观提问，答案在原文有直接对应。
questions.拆句: 题干主干 What was novel about the experiment；过去分词短语 reported in Science 后置修饰 the study，相当于 which was reported in Science。novel 在此意为 "前所未有的、首次的"，与原文 for the first time 直接呼应。
questions.定位: P9 By studying imprinting, the authors of this study have shown for the first time that an animal can learn relationships between concepts without training, said Jeffrey Katz, an experimental psychologist at Auburn University who was not involved in the study. Auburn 大学的实验心理学家 Jeffrey Katz（未参与本研究）表示，通过研究印随现象，本研究作者首次证明动物可以在 "无需训练" 的情况下学会概念之间的关系。

locate.en: By studying imprinting, the authors of this study have shown for the first time that an animal can learn relationships between concepts without training, said Jeffrey Katz, an experimental psychologist at Auburn University who was not involved in the study.
locate.zh: Auburn 大学的实验心理学家 Jeffrey Katz（未参与本研究）表示，通过研究印随现象，本研究作者首次证明动物可以在 "无需训练" 的情况下学会概念之间的关系。

option_analysis.note: 预判 "未受训练即首次"，The animals used received no training 与之严丝合缝；A 是 without training 与 untrained 的标准动宾化改写。

pairs.opt: The animals used received no training
The animals used received no training

experimental psychologist 与 experimental psychologist 只是介绍研究人员身份，从未将 "实验心理学家" 当作本研究的新颖之处；选项 It was conducted by experimental psychologists 把背景信息错认为答案。

questions.stem: What do we learn from Dr. Wasserman's comment on the study of animal minds at the end of the passage?
questions.stem_zh: 从文章结尾Wasserman博士对动物思维研究的评论中我们了解到什么?

options.text: It is getting more and more intricate.
options.zh: 研究正变得越来越复杂。

options.text: Research methods are being updated.
options.zh: 研究方法正在更新。

options.text: It is attracting more public attention.

options.text: Remarkable progress is being made.

questions.判型: What do we learn from Dr. Wasserman's comment...? 限定具体人和具体位置，问其评论传达的客观信息，仍是细节题，不是推断题。
questions.拆句: 主干 What do we learn from Dr. Wasserman's comment；on the study of animal minds 是介词短语限定 comment 的内容范围；at the end of the passage 是位置状语限定 comment 的物理位置。注意 comment on 是固定搭配，意为 "对……的评论"。
questions.定位: P12 We are in a revolutionary phase in terms of our ability to understand the minds of other animals. 在理解其他动物心智的能力方面，我们正处于一个 "革命性的阶段"。

locate.en: We are in a revolutionary phase in terms of our ability to understand the minds of other animals.
locate.zh: 在理解其他动物心智的能力方面，我们正处于一个 "革命性的阶段"。

option_analysis.note: 原文 far more of the intricacies in their world 说的是 "动物世界的复杂性"，不是 "研究本身越来越复杂"；选项 It is getting more and more intricate 把 intricacies 这一原词扎根，但用错了对象。
Wasserman 谈的是认知层面的革命，不是方法层面的革新；原文未提 research methods are being updated。

reading2.title: 2023年3月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: The suggestion that people should aim for dietary diversity by trying to eat a variety of foods has been a basic public health recommendation for decades in the United States and elsewhere. Now, however, experts are warning that aiming for a diverse diet may actually lead to just eating more calories, and, thus, to obesity. One issue is that people may not interpret "variety" the way nutritionists intend. This problem is highlighted by new research conducted by the American Heart Association. Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods. This had implications for obesity, as researchers found a greater prevalence of obesity amongst people with a greater dietary diversity.
passages.zh: 几十年来，在美国及其他地区，公共卫生领域一直基本建议人们通过尝试食用多种食物来实现饮食多样化。然而，如今专家警告说，以饮食多样化为目标实际上可能会导致人们摄入更多热量，进而造成肥胖。问题之一在于，人们对“多样性”的理解可能与营养学家所指的含义不同。美国心脏协会开展的一项新研究凸显了这一问题。研究人员审查了所有与饮食多样性相关的已发表证据，发现饮食多样性与健康食品和不健康食品摄入量的增加均存在相关性。这对肥胖问题有一定影响，因为研究人员发现，饮食多样性较高的人群中肥胖的比例也较高。

passages.en: One author of the new study explained that their findings contradict standard dietary advice, as most dietary guidelines around the world include a statement of eating a variety of foods. But this advice does not seem to be supported by science, possibly because there is little agreement about the meaning of "dietary diversity," which is not clearly and consistently defined. Some experts measure dietary diversity by counting the number of food groups eaten, while others look at the distribution of calories across individual foods, and still others measure how different the foods eaten are from each other.
passages.zh: 这项新研究的一位作者解释说，他们的研究结果与标准饮食建议相矛盾，因为世界各地的大多数膳食指南都包含“食用多种食物”的表述。但这一建议似乎没有得到科学依据的支持，可能是因为人们对“饮食多样性”的含义缺乏共识，而这一概念也没有得到清晰且一致的定义。一些专家通过统计所食用食物组的数量来衡量饮食多样性，另一些专家则考察各种单独食物之间的热量分布，还有一些专家则衡量所食用食物彼此之间的差异程度。

passages.en: Although the findings of this new study contradict standard dietary advice, they do not come as a surprise to all of the researchers involved. Dr. Rao, one of the study authors, noted that, after 20 years of experience in the field of obesity, he has observed that people who have a regimented lifestyle and diet tend to be thinner and healthier than people with a wide variety of consumption. This anecdotal evidence matches the conclusions of the study, which found no evidence that dietary diversity promotes healthy body weight or optimal eating patterns, and limited evidence that eating a variety of foods is actually associated with consuming more calories, poor eating patterns and weight gain. Further, there is some evidence that a greater variety of food options in a single meal may delay people's feeling of fullness and actually increase how much they eat.
passages.zh: 尽管这项新研究的结果与标准饮食建议相矛盾，但并非所有参与研究的人员都对此感到意外。研究作者之一 Rao 医生指出，凭借20年的肥胖研究经验，他观察到，生活方式和饮食较为规律的人往往比饮食种类多样的人更苗条、更健康。这一轶闻式证据与该研究的结论相吻合：研究没有发现饮食多样性能够促进健康的体重或最佳的饮食模式，而有限的证据表明，食用多种食物实际上与摄入更多热量、不良饮食模式以及体重增加有关。此外，有证据表明，一顿饭中食物选择的多样性增加，可能会延迟人们产生饱腹感的时间，实际上使他们吃得更多。

passages.en: Based on their findings, the researchers endorse a diet consisting of a limited number of healthy foods such as vegetables, fruits, grains, and poultry. They also recommend that people simultaneously endeavor to restrict consumption of sweets, sugar and red meat. The researchers stress, however, that their dietary recommendations do not imply dietary diversity is never positive, and that, in the past, diversity in diets of whole, unprocessed food may have actually been very beneficial.
passages.zh: 基于研究结果，研究人员支持由数量有限的健康食品组成的饮食，例如蔬菜、水果、谷物和禽肉。他们还建议人们同时努力限制甜食、糖和红肉的摄入。不过，研究人员强调，他们的饮食建议并不意味着饮食多样性从来没有积极作用；过去，完整且未经加工的食物构成的多样化饮食实际上可能非常有益。

questions.stem: What has been a standard piece of dietary advice for decades?
questions.stem_zh: 几十年来的标准饮食建议是什么?

options.text: People should cultivate a healthy eating habit.
options.zh: 人们应该培养健康的饮食习惯。

options.text: People should have a well-balanced diet.
options.zh: 人们应该均衡饮食。

options.text: People should diversify what they eat.
options.zh: 人们应该多样化饮食。

options.text: People should limit calorie intake to avoid obesity.
options.zh: 人们应该限制热量摄入以避免肥胖。

questions.判型: 题干 What has been a standard piece of dietary advice for decades? 直接发问"几十年来标准建议是什么"，要的是文本陈述的客观事实。
questions.拆句: What has been a standard piece of dietary advice for decades? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，谓语用现在完成时 has been，强调"从过去几十年延续至今的状态"，与 for decades 时间状语呼应；无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 The suggestion that people should aim for dietary diversity by trying to eat a variety of foods has been a basic public health recommendation for decades in the United States and elsewhere. 几十年来，在美国及其他地方，建议人们通过尝试多种食物来追求饮食多样化，一直是一条基本的公共健康建议。

locate.en: The suggestion that people should aim for dietary diversity by trying to eat a variety of foods has been a basic public health recommendation for decades in the United States and elsewhere.
locate.zh: 几十年来，在美国及其他地方，建议人们通过尝试多种食物来追求饮食多样化，一直是一条基本的公共健康建议。

option_analysis.note: cultivate a healthy eating habit 是合理的常识建议，但原文标准建议特指"多样化"而非泛泛的"健康习惯"——属于范围模糊的偷换。
well-balanced diet 在中文里和"多样化"语感相近，但原文用的是 dietary diversity，强调"种类多"而非"营养均衡"，两者不等值。
预判要的是"使饮食多样化"，C 项 diversify what they eat 就是这层意思的标准同义改写，锁定 C。

pairs.orig: aim for dietary diversity by trying to eat a variety of foods

option_analysis.note: limit calorie intake to avoid obesity 是文章后文 obesity 话题的延伸，但题干问的是"几十年来的标准建议"，原文标准建议是 diversity 而非"限制热量"。

questions.stem: What did the new research by the American Heart Association find?
questions.stem_zh: 美国心脏协会的新研究发现了什么?

options.text: People seeking dietary diversity tend to eat more.
options.zh: 追求饮食多样性的人往往吃得更多。

options.text: Big eaters are more likely to become overweight.
options.zh: 食量大的人更容易超重。

options.text: Dietary diversity is positively related to good health.
options.zh: 饮食多样性与良好健康呈正相关。

options.text: Unhealthy food makes people gain weight more easily.
options.zh: 不健康的食物使人更容易增重。

questions.判型: 题干 What did the new research by the American Heart Association find? 问"研究发现了什么"，找的是研究结论的客观陈述。
questions.拆句: What did the new research by the American Heart Association find? 是 What 引导的一般疑问倒装，主干是 the new research found what，by 短语作后置定语；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P1 Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods. This had implications for obesity, as researchers found a greater prevalence of obesity amongst people with a greater dietary diversity. 研究者回顾了所有已发表的与饮食多样化相关的证据，发现饮食多样化与摄入更多健康和不健康食物之间存在相关性。这对肥胖问题有重要含义，因为研究者发现，饮食多样化程度更高的人群中肥胖患病率也更高。

locate.en: Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods. This had implications for obesity, as researchers found a greater prevalence of obesity amongst people with a greater dietary diversity.
locate.zh: 研究者回顾了所有已发表的与饮食多样化相关的证据，发现饮食多样化与摄入更多健康和不健康食物之间存在相关性。这对肥胖问题有重要含义，因为研究者发现，饮食多样化程度更高的人群中肥胖患病率也更高。

option_analysis.note: 预判是"多样化与吃得更多相关"，A 项 People seeking dietary diversity tend to eat more 即此意，且与原文 correlation 关系无矛盾，锁定 A。

pairs.orig: a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods
pairs.opt: People seeking dietary diversity tend to eat more

option_analysis.note: Big eaters are more likely to become overweight 的主语是"吃得多的人"，而原文论述对象是"追求多样化的人"；"吃得多→变胖"是常识，但不是本研究发现的关系。
原文说多样化与"更多肥胖患病率"相关，是负面相关；positively related to good health 却说与"健康"正相关——意思完全相反。
Unhealthy food makes people gain weight more easily 是常识，但原文研究发现的是"多样化与吃得更多/肥胖率高"相关，并非"不健康食物本身致胖"。

questions.stem: What could help to explain the contradiction between the new findings and the common public health recommendation?
questions.stem_zh: 什么可以帮助解释新发现与常见公共卫生建议之间的矛盾?

options.text: Most dietary guidelines around the world contradict one another.
options.zh: 世界各地的大多数饮食指南相互矛盾。

options.text: Conventional wisdom about diet is seldom supported by science.
options.zh: 关于饮食的传统观念很少得到科学支持。

options.text: The methods researchers use to measure nutrition vary greatly.
options.zh: 研究人员测量营养的方法差异很大。

options.text: There is little consensus on the definition of dietary diversity.
options.zh: 对饮食多样性的定义几乎没有共识。

questions.判型: 题干 What could help to explain the contradiction 要求找原文给出的解释，答案是文本中明示的原因陈述。
questions.拆句: What could help to explain the contradiction between the new findings and the common public health recommendation? 主干是 What could help to explain the contradiction，between A and B 双介短语作 contradiction 的后置定语；结构略长但平铺直叙，无陷阱。
questions.定位: P2 But this advice does not seem to be supported by science, possibly because there is little agreement about the meaning of "dietary diversity," which is not clearly and consistently defined. 但这一建议似乎并未得到科学的支持，可能是因为对于"饮食多样化"的含义，学界几乎没有共识——它本身就没有清晰一致的定义。

locate.en: But this advice does not seem to be supported by science, possibly because there is little agreement about the meaning of "dietary diversity," which is not clearly and consistently defined.
locate.zh: 但这一建议似乎并未得到科学的支持，可能是因为对于"饮食多样化"的含义，学界几乎没有共识——它本身就没有清晰一致的定义。

option_analysis.note: Most dietary guidelines around the world contradict one another 把"指南间彼此矛盾"安给原文，原文实际说的是"新研究与指南矛盾"，而不是"指南之间矛盾"。
Conventional wisdom about diet is seldom supported by science 把原文"这条建议似乎未被科学支持"扩大为"所有饮食常识都很少被科学支持"，从个例跳到普遍规律。
The methods researchers use to measure nutrition vary greatly 把"测量饮食多样化的方法不同"偷换为"测量营养的方法不同"——nutrition ≠ dietary diversity，主体偏离。

translation.title: 2023年3月·第1套英语六级汉译英（段落翻译） · 张骞出使西域的历史人物叙述 参考译文与解析
translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 张骞(Zhang Qian)是中国第一个伟大的探险家。他不畏艰险,克服重重困难,两次出使西域,开通了中国同西亚和欧洲的通商关系,将中国的丝和丝织品运往西亚和欧洲,开拓了历史上著名的"丝绸之路"。同时,他又将西域的风土人情、地理文化以及特有物种等介绍到中原,极大地开阔了人们的视野。 正如历史学家所指出的那样,如果没有张骞出使西域,就不可能有丝绸之路的开辟,也就不会有汉朝同西域或欧洲的文化交流。
translation.reference_en:
Zhang Qian was the first great explorer in Chinese history. Braving dangers and overcoming numerous difficulties, he made two journeys to the Western Regions, opened up trade between China, West Asia and Europe, transported Chinese silk and silk fabrics there, and thereby pioneered the famous Silk Road in history. Meanwhile, he introduced the local customs, geography, culture and unique species of the Western Regions to the Central Plains, greatly broadening people's horizons. As historians have pointed out, without Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions, there would have been no opening of the Silk Road, nor any cultural exchanges between the Han Dynasty and the Western Regions or Europe.
【衔接】
第1句到第2句：用人名引出后改用代词he承接第1句已点出主语全名 Zhang Qian，第2、3句继续讲他的作为，主语改用代词 he 承接（he made two journeys...），不必每句重复 Zhang Qian；指代清晰又不啰嗦。对应中文 他不畏艰险、他又将西域的风土人情 里的"他"。
第2句到第3句：补Meanwhile显并列递进第3句句首 同时 是关键连接信号，译为 Meanwhile（或 At the same time）放句首，把"打通商路"与"传播文化"两桩功绩并列起来，让读者看出这是张骞的另一面贡献，而非两件孤立的事。
第3句到第4句：用As historians引出总评作收束第4句 正如历史学家所指出的那样 是对前文功绩的总评定性，用 As historians have pointed out 起头，把全篇从"罗列事迹"自然过渡到"历史评价"，形成首尾呼应的收尾，整篇结构更完整。

main_idea.core: 张骞出使西域的历史人物叙述
main_idea.detail: 这段在讲一位历史人物的功绩：张骞(Zhang Qian)是中国第一个伟大的探险家，随后通篇都是他做过的事——出使、开通、运送、开拓、介绍。属于典型的历史叙述语体（讲过去发生、已经完成的事），而非介绍某事物现状的客观说明文。这一判断直接决定下面用一般过去时作基调。

tense.detail: 通篇都在讲张骞（汉朝人）已经做完的事：两次出使西域,开通了中国同西亚和欧洲的通商关系、开拓了历史上著名的"丝绸之路"，动作都发生在两千多年前、且已完结，所以全篇默认用一般过去时。只有最后一句的虚拟假设（如果没有……就不会有……）要偏离基调，改用与过去事实相反的虚拟语气。

term_notes.detail: 拟定统一译法 Zhang Qian。原文已给出括注 张骞(Zhang Qian)，是官方给定的人名拼写，直接采用，全篇人名只用这一种拼写、首字母大写，不要再自造 Zhangqian 或加翻译。这是约定俗成的音译人名。
拟定统一译法 the Western Regions（首字母大写、加定冠词 the）。两次出使西域 是历史专名（汉代对今新疆及中亚一带的统称），用约定俗成的意译加定冠词，全篇 4 处"西域"都用同一译法，不要一会儿 west area 一会儿 western land。
拟定统一译法 the Silk Road（首字母大写、加定冠词，这是世界通用的固定专名）。开拓了历史上著名的"丝绸之路"，全篇用同一译法，不要写成 silk way / road of silk。
拟定统一译法 the Central Plains（首字母大写、加定冠词、Plains 用复数）。介绍到中原 指汉朝核心地区，用约定俗成的意译，与"西域"形成地理对照。
拟定统一译法 the Han Dynasty（the + Han + Dynasty，首字母均大写）。也就不会有汉朝同西域或欧洲的文化交流，朝代名是固定译法，全篇统一。

steps.text: Zhang Qian was explorer（主系表）（主语策略：原句主语）这是"A是B"的判断句，主语用原句已有的 张骞(Zhang Qian)，谓语用系动词 was，表语是 the first great explorer。主干即 Zhang Qian was the first great explorer，再把"中国"挂上去说明范围。
"中国第一个伟大的"全作前置定语本句很短、结构简单，无需降级成从句。"第一个""伟大的"是形容词，按英文习惯叠在名词 explorer 前作前置定语：the first great explorer；"中国（的）"表范围，可处理成 in China 后置，或 in Chinese history，挂在 explorer 之后，避免一串修饰全压在名词前显得拥挤。
时态回指全篇基调用一般过去时，系动词用 was（张骞是古人，不是 is）。 冠词与序数词序数词 first 前必须加定冠词 the：the first great explorer；漏掉 the 是高频硬伤。 单复数explorer 此处特指张骞一人，用单数。
Zhang Qian was the first great explorer in Chinese history.
He + 一串并列谓语（主语策略：原句主语）本句一个主语 他（指张骞）贯穿到底，后面跟着"不畏""克服""出使""开通""运往""开拓"一连串动作。骨架定为 He, ..., made two trips / journeys to the Western Regions，把"两次出使西域"这个核心壮举作为主干谓语，其余分句分别降级或并列安放，避免六个动词全用 and 平铺。

前提降级为分词、成就拆成并列分句"不畏艰险，克服重重困难"是出使的前提条件，降级成现在分词短语 Braving dangers and overcoming numerous difficulties 作状语，置于句首。"开通了……通商关系""将丝和丝织品运往……""开拓了丝绸之路"是出使带来的几项成就，因信息量大，拆成主干之后用分号或 thereby + 分词连接的并列结构：he opened up trade between China and West Asia and Europe, transported Chinese silk and silk fabrics there, and pioneered the famous Silk Road，用一个 and 串起的并列谓语收束，避免写成六段流水。

时态回指全篇基调用一般过去时：made / opened / transported / pioneered 全用过去式。 单复数"丝织品"是多种、用复数 silk fabrics；"困难"重重、用复数 difficulties；"两次"出使 made two journeys 用复数 journeys。 介词搭配"开通……通商关系"用 open up trade between A and B；"运往"用 transport ... to ... 或承前用 there；"出使（前往）西域"用 to。 专名统一"西域"= the Western Regions、"丝绸之路"= the Silk Road，回指 glossary、加定冠词大写。

Braving dangers and overcoming numerous difficulties, he made two journeys to the Western Regions, opened up trade between China, West Asia and Europe, transported Chinese silk and silk fabrics there, and thereby pioneered the famous Silk Road in history.

He introduced ... to the Central Plains（主语策略：原句主语）主语仍是 他（he），核心动词"介绍到"作谓语 introduced，宾语是"西域的风土人情、地理文化以及特有物种"，地点状语"到中原"= to the Central Plains。主干即 he introduced the customs, geography, culture and unique species of the Western Regions to the Central Plains。

"极大地开阔视野"降级为结果状语句首 同时 译为 Meanwhile/At the same time 作连接状语。后半句"极大地开阔了人们的视野"是"介绍"带来的结果，不另起一句，降级成现在分词短语 greatly broadening people’s horizons 作结果状语挂在主干后；并列的几个宾语（风土人情、地理文化、特有物种）用 and 连成名词并列，共一个 of the Western Regions 收尾。
时态回指全篇基调用一般过去时：introduced 用过去式。 单复数"特有物种"不止一种、用复数 species（单复同形，但配 unique 取复数义）；"人们的视野"用 people’s horizons，horizon 在"眼界"义上常用复数。 专名统一"西域"=the Western Regions、"中原"=the Central Plains，回指 glossary、加定冠词大写。
Meanwhile, he introduced the local customs, geography, culture and unique species of the Western Regions to the Central Plains, greatly broadening people's horizons.

There would have been no ...（虚拟存在句）（主语策略：There be）"就不可能有……开辟""也就不会有……交流"都是"（不会）存在某事物"，用 There be 句型表存在最贴切；又因是与过去事实相反的假设（如果没有张骞出使西域），主句用虚拟语气 There would have been no...。前面 正如历史学家所指出的那样 作插入状语 As historians have pointed out。

条件句 + 两个并列 no 结果"如果没有张骞出使西域"是条件从句，与过去相反，用 Without Zhang Qian’s mission to the Western Regions 介词短语表条件（比 If there had been no... 更简洁），或 Had it not been for...。两个结果分句"不可能有丝绸之路开辟""不会有文化交流"是并列，合进一个 There would have been no A, nor B 结构，用 nor 承接第二个否定，避免重复 there would have been no。

虚拟语气与过去事实相反，主句用 would have + 过去分词（would have been），不能用一般过去时 was/were；这是本句最易错也最显水平处。 时态（插入语）"历史学家所指出的"是延续到现在的评价，用现在完成时 have pointed out，可不必受全篇过去时基调约束。 专名统一"西域"=the Western Regions、"丝绸之路"=the Silk Road、"汉朝"=the Han Dynasty，回指 glossary。 单复数"历史学家"泛指一类人、用复数 historians；"文化交流"用 cultural exchanges（交流多次、用复数）。

As historians have pointed out, without Zhang Qian's mission to the Western Regions, there would have been no opening of the Silk Road, nor any cultural exchanges between the Han Dynasty and the Western Regions or Europe.
